about.description:
FFCx is a new version of the FEniCS Form Compiler.
It is being actively developed and is compatible with DOLFINx.

FFCx is a compiler for finite element variational forms.
From a high-level description of the form in the Unified Form Language (UFL),
it generates efficient low-level C code that can be used to assemble the corresponding discrete operator (tensor).
In particular, a bilinear form may be assembled into a matrix and a linear form may be assembled into a vector.
FFCx may be used either from the command line (by invoking the ffcx command) or as a Python module (import ffcx).

raw_meta_yaml:
# pins are usually updated on minor bumps:
# basix is currently co-versioned with ffcx
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: fenics-ffcx-ufcx
  version: "0.11.0"
  major_minor: "${{ (version | split('.'))[:2] | join('.') }}"
  ufl_version: "2026.1"
  python_min: "3.11"

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/fenics/ffcx/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7df1c086c0398b72343a5f047c7e6aa17ea05f1ba123e3e0ca858d6a133b13bd

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: fenics-ufcx
    build:
      noarch: generic
      script:
        file: build-ufcx
        env: 
          # workaround https://github.com/prefix-dev/rattler-build/issues/2475
          ProgramFiles: ${{ env.get("ProgramFiles", default="") }}
          ProgramFiles(x86): ${{ env.get("ProgramFiles(x86)", default="") }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
      host: []
      run:
        - if: not win
          then: __unix
          else: __win
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - ${{ compiler("c") }}
          - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - ufcx.h
      - script:
          # rattler-build bug: executes .sh on Windows with .bat
          # for noarch: generic package
          file: test-ufcx${{ '.bat' if win else '' }}
          env:
            # workaround https://github.com/prefix-dev/rattler-build/issues/2475
            target_platform: ${{ 'win-64' if win else 'linux-64' }}
        files:
          recipe:
            - test-ufcx/
        requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
            - cmake
            - ninja
            - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
  - package:
      name: fenics-ffcx
    build:
      noarch: python
      python:
        entry_points:
          - ffcx = ffcx:__main__.main
      script:
        file: build-ffcx-py
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - setuptools >=62
        - wheel
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - setuptools >=77.0.3
        - numpy >=1.21
        - cffi
        - fenics-basix ${{ major_minor }}.*
        - fenics-ufl ${{ ufl_version }}.*
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - ffcx
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "3.14.*"
      - files:
          source:
            - test
        requirements:
          run:
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
            - pip
            - numba
            - pytest
            - sympy
            - pygraphviz
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        script:
          - python -m pytest -v -k "not bilinear" test
